evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml runs on pull_request and push to main, with workflow-level `permissions: contents: read`. It runs `npm ci`, `npm test` (whose pretest is prepare-data) and `npm run build` (which includes svelte-check) in site/. All of these scripts exist in site/package.json, the only package.json in the repo. There is no pull_request_target and the only token is `github.token`. pages.yml is triggered by `push: branches: [main]` and also by `workflow_dispatch`, and no job checks `github.ref`, so a manual run from any branch would build and deploy unless the github-pages environment rule blocks it. CONTRIBUTING only says that environment 'may restrict deployments to main'. Every action is referenced by a mutable tag, not a commit SHA: actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, configure-pages@v5, upload-pages-artifact@v3, deploy-pages@v4 (step1.patch lines 58-59, 100-107, 114, 127, 152-155). pages.yml grants `pages: write` and `id-token: write` at workflow level, so the build job gets them too even though it doesn't need them. release.yml runs on `v*` tags with contents: write. It checks that the tag is on origin/main and matches package.json, then runs test and build before calling `gh release create`. Nothing was run, pushed or published.
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch lines 322-390) covers install (`cd site && npm ci`), develop (`npm run dev`), test (`npm test`), build (`npm run build`), preview, `PAGES_BASE`, `prepare-data` and `sample-bullets`. All of these exist in site/package.json, and vite.config.ts reads PAGES_BASE. It explains data contribution and links issue templates (.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/data.yml and bullet.yml both exist) and CONTRIBUTING. The license is MIT, and LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY.md both exist. It correctly says commands run from site/ and names Node 22.
evidence.s1_release: There is one consistent strategy. The version lives in site/package.json (0.1.0), tags are vX.Y.Z, and SemVer rules are spelled out. The release steps are: rename Unreleased, run `npm version --no-git-tag-version`, commit `chore(release)`, then tag on main. release.yml enforces tag = package.json and that the tag is on main, and pulls the notes from CHANGELOG. CHANGELOG states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 and its heading format. Dependabot covers npm in /site (grouped minor/patch) and github-actions, with prefixes build(deps)/ci(deps) that match the convention. Conventional Commits 1.0.0 is documented with a type table. All 11 commits follow the format, but a few types are off: `33a4576 fix:` for config/CI alignment where the table says ci/build, and `8d5263d feat(site): test the comparison table…` for a mostly-test commit.
evidence.s2_requirements: Route `#/compare/<a>/<b>` is parsed and built in router.ts lines 34-42 and 64, and since it is a hash route it survives a reload. The SVG has role=img and aria-label 'Profiles of {a} and {b}' (CompareFigure.svelte). There is one `path` per outline, with both profiles in one viewport via viewportFor and the head face at z=0. Shot cartridges are excluded. The table has the caption `Dimensions (mm|in)` and the headers Symbol / name A / name B / Difference. Rows use FIELD_LABELS, take millimetre fields of the `cartridge` part only (FIELD_UNITS excluded, Tol fields dropped by orderedFields), and Difference is B−A. Units follow unitSystem(), the store behind the Settings select. Metric values use formatValue; imperial uses displayNumber. Cartridge.svelte has a 'Compare with' NativeSelect listing the other (non-shot) cartridges by name and a 'Compare' button that sets href.compare(key, target). German strings were added for every key.
evidence.s2_correctness: compare.ts dimensions() walks the cartridge groups in GROUP_ORDER/orderedFields order, so rows follow the detail page. The test values match the records: L6 71.12/84.84/13.72, e min 1.4/0.94/-0.46, f 0.38/0.41/0.03. Differences go through displayNumber(…, unit), which drops the float noise of 84.84-71.12; the step says differences are written 'the same way' as values, and this is a defensible reading. Imperial values come from displayNumber (39.62 mm → 1.55984251969 in). profileOverlay feeds caseOuterProfile(adaptMetallic(record)) into one shared viewportFor and fullSectionPath, so scale, axis and head face (z=0 → same x) agree. A record that cannot be built (missing R1) shows the reason instead of crashing. Shotshell pairs show a message.
evidence.s2_fit: Reuses lib/shapes2d (adaptMetallic, caseOuterProfile), lib/geom (viewportFor, fullSectionPath), lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields, formatValue), site units.ts displayNumber, units.svelte unitSystem, and the shadcn Label/NativeSelect/Button and i18n `t`. It follows the lazy-chunk route pattern in App.svelte and updates metadata.ts and SiteNavigation. One small duplication: compare.ts lines 287-289 re-implement the known-then-sorted group ordering that `orderedGroups` in site/src/lib/fields.ts already provides. Component tests via `svelte/server` are a new pattern in this repo, but they are minimal.
evidence.s2_tests: compare.test.ts checks the exact row list and order, that FIELD_UNITS and Tol fields are excluded, the symbol labels, values, B−A, the absence of float noise, the imperial conversion and zero differences. It also checks that the overlay has 2 paths with the same head-face x and the longer case drawn longer, and that an undrawable record throws. CompareFigure.test checks role=img, the exact accessible name and exactly two path/polyline/polygon elements. CompareTable.test checks the caption in both units, the exact headers and the cell order. router.test covers the round-trip and malformed compare hashes. Not covered: the 'Compare with' control on Cartridge.svelte, the German strings, and an actual imperial table render through Compare.svelte.
evidence.s3_fixes: Bug: compareRows (step3.patch lines 59-81) now builds the union of both symbol sets. A B-only symbol is inserted after the symbol that precedes it in B (R3 after R1, delta L last). Missing cells and Difference are ''. Tests assert delta L {a:'0.1', b:'', difference:''} and R3 {a:'', b:'13.51'}, and the full order list was updated. The 'noShared' text was reworded to match the new condition (related, not unrelated). Style: CompareTable.svelte already had `text-right` on the two name headers, the Difference header and their cells since step 2, with the Symbol column left-aligned, mirroring GroupTable's `th,td{text-align:right}` + first-child left. Tailwind utilities sit in a layer above `legacy`, so these take effect and no change was needed. The changelog entry was amended under Unreleased. No other files were touched.
evidence.cross_step: Step 2 adds an `Added` line under `## [Unreleased]`, and step 3 amends it (correct for an unreleased feature under Keep a Changelog). Per the stated strategy the version only changes in a `chore(release)` commit, so leaving 0.1.0 untouched is consistent. Step 2/3 commits use `feat(site)` / `fix(site)` Conventional Commits. New code compiles under the existing svelte-check and vitest setup (types line up; the test fixture helper @lib/testing/fixtures exists), so CI's `npm test` and `npm run build` should pass. I did not run them.

unmet_requirements: Step 1 / CI criteria: GitHub Actions are referenced by mutable tags (@v4, @v5, @v3), not pinned to full commit SHAs
Step 1: pages.yml accepts workflow_dispatch from any branch without a ref check, so Pages deployment is not strictly limited to main
Step 1: pages.yml grants pages: write and id-token: write at workflow level, so the build job holds them without need (not least privilege per job)
strengths: The compare feature fully reuses lib/shapes2d, lib/geom, lib/core and the site's unit, i18n and UI components, and it meets every step 2 requirement, including exact accessible names, headers, symbol labels and both unit systems.
The step 3 bug fix merges both cartridges' symbols in detail-page order, with empty cells and Difference, and precise tests (delta L, R3).

Release setup is coherent and enforced: version in site/package.json, a tag-triggered release that checks tag = version, tag on main and a CHANGELOG section, Keep a Changelog format, Dependabot with prefixes matching the documented Conventional Commits, and a README whose commands all exist.
issues: None of the workflow actions are pinned to commit SHAs (actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, configure-pages@v5, upload-pages-artifact@v3, deploy-pages@v4).
pages.yml's workflow_dispatch trigger has no `github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'` guard, and pages: write and id-token: write are granted at workflow level, so the build job holds them too.
Minor: compare.ts duplicates the group-ordering logic of site/src/lib/fields.ts orderedGroups, and a few commit types are off convention (`fix:` for CI config, `feat(site): test …`).
review.verdict: The compare view is correct, well tested, reuses the repository's libraries, meets the step 2 spec, and the step 3 comment is fully addressed (alignment was already right-aligned in step 2). The release and documentation setup is solid, but the CI and Pages workflows miss SHA pinning and leave manual Pages deploys open to any branch, which should be fixed before merging.
